item.title: Connecting the dots: Business history research on social entrepreneurship in the Global South
item.dc:title: Connecting the dots: Business history research on social entrepreneurship in the Global South
item.dc:creator: Léna Prouchet Business Humanities and Law, Copenhagen Business School, Copenhagen, DenmarkLéna Prouchet is a postdoctoral researcher on the Rethinking Entrepreneurship in Society project at the Department of Business Humanities and Law at Copenhagen Business School. Her work focuses on the involvement of Indigenous and local communities in Latin America in developmental entrepreneurial initiatives. Additionally, using the concept of “entrepreneurialism”—which frames entrepreneurship as a social and cultural discourse—she investigates why entrepreneurship has become a dominant paradigm in contemporary development strategies.
